current_path: See thesis report Appendix 1; source dataset references are not duplicated as raw imagery in this folder
description: Lists the 58 drone-image projects, their platform identifiers, dataset groups, study partition, image counts, country, resolution, and data source. Raw images are not included here because the output folder contains processed research outputs rather than the original image datasets. Some datasets are private or institutionally provided, and the full raw data would be too large for this shared output package.
keep_reason: Appendix 1 remains in the report; raw public/private source data is referenced rather than redistributed.

description: Descriptor table for unseen test projects. These descriptors were used by the final scoring models when selecting candidate multiplier combinations.

description: Short readable summary of the Ridge Regression coefficient export.
